info.title: Unofficial NBA 2K27 Build Optimizer API
info.description: Unofficial NBA 2K27 build planning tool. Not affiliated with or endorsed by 2K or the NBA. A build is recommended only when every mechanic it depends on is verified.

post.description:
Search verified bodies outside the event loop.

FastAPI runs this synchronous handler on a threadpool. One request shares
one deadline across bodies. The shipped ruleset has no verified coverage,
so the response stays unsupported.

schema.title: Response Optimize Build Api V1 Optimize Post

AttributeDescriptor.title: AttributeDescriptor
AttributeDescriptor.description: Present so clients have a typed attribute dictionary. Empty until rules are verified.

BadgeTier.title: BadgeTier
BadgeTier.description: Request vocabulary from the product contract, not a verified eligibility table.

BuildType.title: BuildType
BuildType.description: Player model. Legal measurement ranges are verified rules, not this enum.

rules_loaded.title: Rules Loaded
rules_loaded.description: True when the active manifest parsed. This does not mean any mechanic is verified.

LockedInches.title: LockedInches
LockedInches.description: Inches field. The numeric bound is an API limit, not a legal body range.

LockedPounds.title: LockedPounds
LockedPounds.description: Pounds field. The numeric bound is an API limit, not a legal body range.

UnlockDescriptor.title: UnlockDescriptor
UnlockDescriptor.description: Verified badge, animation, or Takeover id. Label repeats the id; no display name is stored.
